One trip. Everyone included. Every expense accounted for.
From the first plan to the last bill

Your trip, in three simple steps.

A weekend away or a bigger adventure: keep the group organised from start to finish.

01 / GET TOGETHER

Create a trip. Invite your people.

Make a trip and share its invitation code or QR code. Friends join the same space for expenses, members, and activity.

02 / ADD AS YOU GO

Record it once. Split it clearly.

Add meals, stays, transport, and other shared costs. Choose who paid, who shares the expense, and how much each person owes.

03 / WRAP THINGS UP

Check balances. Record settlements.

See who owes whom, open a supported UPI app for INR payments, and record a settlement after checking the payment.

A closer look

Everything the group needs.
All in one trip.

01 / Expenses & receipts

Spend a moment.
Save the details.

Add an expense manually or scan a receipt. Review the recognised details, confirm who paid, and select the people sharing the cost.

  • Keep meals, accommodation, transport, and other trip costs together.
  • Scan receipts and check the recognised amounts before saving.
  • Track the payer and each member's share.
02 / Flexible splits

Equal shares.
Or your own amounts.

Split an expense equally, or enter exact amounts for individual members. When some shares are set, TripWallet can divide the remainder among the others.

  • Select who participates in each expense.
  • Set exact shares when everyone spent differently.
  • Review the split before saving the expense.
03 / Balances & settlements

Know where
everyone stands.

See the group's balances and who owes whom. Save an optional UPI ID in your profile to make future payment handoffs easier.

  • Review the recipient and amount before paying.
  • For INR payments, open a supported external UPI app with details prefilled.
  • Confirm the payment yourself and record the settlement.

TripWallet tracks expenses and settlement records. Payments take place in external apps; TripWallet does not process money or independently verify payment success.

04 / Shared activity

Stay in the loop.
Enjoy the journey.

Follow your group's updates, organised by trip. Shared records sync when an internet connection is available.

  • Keep updates connected to the right trip.
  • Review expenses and changes in the group's activity.
  • Keep itinerary details alongside your shared costs.
The little things, taken care of
